notes.title: New Update 1.1.0
notes.content: [p]We present to you the first full-fledged update, with the addition of a new game mode.[/p][h3]What's New:[/h3][list][*][p]Singleplayer mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Records are now separated by difficulty levels and game modes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added AZERTY support. On first launch, players with French localization will have the AZERTY layout selected by default. The current layout can be changed in the settings: Video/Screen/Layout.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Minor Fixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where menu buttons would disappear if "Back" was pressed on the main button layer.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted collisions on a level.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the checkpoint sequence on "Hard" difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to use cooperative jump throughout the entire location.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Records are now separated by difficulty levels and game modes.
Added AZERTY support. On first launch, players with French localization will have the AZERTY layout selected by default. The current layout can be changed in the settings: Video/Screen/Layout.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where menu buttons would disappear if "Back" was pressed on the main button layer.

tags.balance_change: Changed the checkpoint sequence on "Hard" difficulty.

tags.feature: Added the ability to use cooperative jump throughout the entire location.

notes.content: [h2]Change List[/h2][list][*][p]Optimized netcode. Issues with bicycle "teleportation" have been eliminated. Also reduced input latency for the client.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the rotation force when tilting the bicycle. Performing tricks in the air is now much easier.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Fix List[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the restart effect did not play for the Client if the bicycle entered a tunnel in the car location.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Client did not hear the sound of cannon shots.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Host saw a "Waiting for players" message over the loading interface.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Optimized netcode. Issues with bicycle "teleportation" have been eliminated. Also reduced input latency for the client.

tags.balance_change: Increased the rotation force when tilting the bicycle. Performing tricks in the air is now much easier.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the restart effect did not play for the Client if the bicycle entered a tunnel in the car location.
Fixed a bug where the Client did not hear the sound of cannon shots.
Fixed a bug where the Host saw a "Waiting for players" message over the loading interface.

notes.content: [h2]Change List[/h2][list][*][p]When loading a race, all players start simultaneously. You won't lose a single second waiting for your partner anymore![/p][/*][*][p]Added restart zones in the tunnels on the car location.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Fix List[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where both players would start the game as the rear rider if the Host chose to change position in the lobby before the Client connected.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the client incorrectly displayed the notification about reaching a new checkpoint.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the settings might not match the displayed values in the menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the client's camera could tilt to the side.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed sounds during level loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the client saw tutorials when re-entering already completed areas.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: When loading a race, all players start simultaneously. You won't lose a single second waiting for your partner anymore!
Added restart zones in the tunnels on the car location.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where both players would start the game as the rear rider if the Host chose to change position in the lobby before the Client connected.
Fixed a bug where the client incorrectly displayed the notification about reaching a new checkpoint.
Fixed a bug where the settings might not match the displayed values in the menu.
Fixed a bug where the client's camera could tilt to the side.
Fixed a bug where the client saw tutorials when re-entering already completed areas.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content: [h2]Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]Added the option to join the studio’s Discord directly from the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the pause menu was accessible during level loading.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The pause menu now shows the current difficulty level instead of the game version.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added the option to join the studio’s Discord directly from the main menu.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where the pause menu was accessible during level loading.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.content: [h2][b]Fix List[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect localization text in several UI elements.[/p][/*][*][p]Closed several spots where players could get stuck and lose progress.[/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2][h2][b]Change List[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Added several checkpoints on "Medium" difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Added difficulty level descriptions in the lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the size of steering wheels.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: - Fixed incorrect localization text in several UI elements.
- Closed several spots where players could get stuck and lose progress.

tags.feature: - Added difficulty level descriptions in the lobby.

tags.balance_change: - Increased the size of steering wheels.
